raw_findings.body: `_lookupSubType` returns undefined for the unmatched id, and the mapped array is assigned unconditionally (unlike the singular branch which checks `if (hydrated)`), producing an array containing `undefined` entries while the original raw `_ids` key is deleted, causing later `.get()` calls on those entries to throw or silently misbehave
raw_findings.failure_mode: Silent data corruption / runtime TypeError when consuming code accesses properties on undefined array entries
raw_findings.impact: `_lookupSubType` returns undefined for the unmatched id, and the mapped array is assigned unconditionally (unlike the singular branch which checks `if (hydrated)`), producing an array containing `undefined` entries while the original raw `_ids` key is deleted, causing later `.get()` calls on those entries to throw or silently misbehave
raw_findings.root_cause: New plural-id hydration path omits the existence check that the singular path performs before overwriting/deleting the raw id field
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Filter out falsy results before assigning, e.g. `obj[self.pluralize(subType)] = obj[k].map(...).filter(Boolean);` mirroring the singular branch's guard
raw_findings.title: Plural sub-type hydration doesn't filter unmatched IDs, injecting undefined entries
raw_findings.trigger: A `_ids` field (e.g. `color_ids`) references an id that is not present in the corresponding root collection (e.g. root.colors is missing that id)

raw_findings.root_cause: Migration assumes the embed_category setting always resolves to an existing category via INNER JOIN, ignoring the common blank/no-match case

validated_findings.root_cause: New plural-id hydration path omits the existence check that the singular path performs before overwriting/deleting the raw id field
validated_findings.suggested_fix: Filter out falsy results before assigning, e.g. `obj[self.pluralize(subType)] = obj[k].map(...).filter(Boolean);` mirroring the singular branch's guard
validated_findings.title: Plural sub-type hydration doesn't filter unmatched IDs, injecting undefined entries
validated_findings.trigger: A `_ids` field (e.g. `color_ids`) references an id that is not present in the corresponding root collection (e.g. root.colors is missing that id)
validated_findings.verifier_reason: Patch lines 196-200 show plural hydration unconditionally assigns `hydrated || []` and deletes the key, while singular branch (lines 203-207) checks `if (hydrated)` before assignment. `_lookupSubType` can return undefined for missing IDs, so array may contain undefined entries.

validated_findings.body: Calling `.sub!` on nil raises `NoMethodError`, causing an unhandled 500 error instead of a normal validation failure response
validated_findings.failure_mode: Unhandled exception on save instead of graceful ActiveRecord validation error
validated_findings.impact: Calling `.sub!` on nil raises `NoMethodError`, causing an unhandled 500 error instead of a normal validation failure response
validated_findings.root_cause: New before_validation callback assumes host is always a String and never nil
validated_findings.suggested_fix: Guard against nil before mutating, e.g. `self.host = self.host.to_s.sub(...).sub(...)` or `return if host.blank?` at the top of the callback
validated_findings.title: before_validation crashes with NoMethodError when host is nil
validated_findings.trigger: EmbeddableHost is validated/saved with a nil host, e.g. `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host` when `params[:embeddable_host][:host]` is missing
validated_findings.verifier_reason: Patch lines 5-8 show `before_validation` calling `self.host.sub!()` without nil guard. If host is nil, `sub!` raises NoMethodError. This is new code introduced by the patch.

validated_findings.body: The SQL comparison `lower(host) = 'EvilTrout.com'` never matches a lowercase-stored host, so a legitimately allowed host is rejected (embedding blocked) due to case mismatch
validated_findings.failure_mode: False negative in host allow-list lookup, denying legitimately configured hosts
validated_findings.impact: The SQL comparison `lower(host) = 'EvilTrout.com'` never matches a lowercase-stored host, so a legitimately allowed host is rejected (embedding blocked) due to case mismatch
validated_findings.root_cause: SQL predicate normalizes only one operand's case, leaving asymmetric case sensitivity
validated_findings.suggested_fix: Lowercase the comparison value too, e.g. `where("lower(host) = ?", host.downcase).first`
validated_findings.title: Case-insensitive host matching only normalizes DB side, not the input host
validated_findings.trigger: A referer URL has a mixed-case host (e.g. 'http://EvilTrout.com') while the stored EmbeddableHost.host is lowercase
validated_findings.verifier_reason: Patch line 17 shows `where("lower(host) = ?", host).first` where `host` comes from `uri.host` (line 14) which preserves original case. Only DB side is lowercased, causing case-sensitive mismatch.

validated_findings.body: `host` is nil and `save_host` calls `host.host=` on nil, raising NoMethodError and returning a 500 error instead of a 404/graceful error
validated_findings.evidence:
def update
    host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first
    save_host(host)
  end
validated_findings.failure_mode: Unhandled exception surfaced as a 500 error for a routine not-found case
validated_findings.impact: `host` is nil and `save_host` calls `host.host=` on nil, raising NoMethodError and returning a 500 error instead of a 404/graceful error
validated_findings.root_cause: Missing nil-check after ActiveRecord lookup before mutating the record
validated_findings.suggested_fix: Check for nil and render a 404/error response before calling save_host, e.g. `raise Discourse::NotFound unless host`
validated_findings.title: Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#update crashes on unknown id instead of returning an error
validated_findings.trigger: PUT request to update an embeddable host with an :id that doesn't exist (e.g., already deleted, race condition, or forged id)
validated_findings.verifier_reason: Patch lines 9-11 show `update` fetches host with `.first` which returns nil for missing ID, then passes to `save_host` which calls `host.host=` on nil, raising NoMethodError.

validated_findings.title: Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#destroy crashes on unknown id instead of returning an error

validated_findings.body: The INNER JOIN yields zero rows, so the query result is empty; indexing `[0]` returns nil and calling `['id']` on nil raises NoMethodError, aborting the migration for the majority of installations
validated_findings.evidence:
category_id = execute("SELECT c.id FROM categories AS c
                        INNER JOIN site_settings AS s ON s.value = c.name
                        WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'")[0]['id'].to_i
validated_findings.failure_mode: Migration fails to run, blocking deployment/upgrade for typical installs
validated_findings.impact: The INNER JOIN yields zero rows, so the query result is empty; indexing `[0]` returns nil and calling `['id']` on nil raises NoMethodError, aborting the migration for the majority of installations
validated_findings.root_cause: Migration assumes the embed_category setting always resolves to an existing category via INNER JOIN, ignoring the common blank/no-match case
validated_findings.suggested_fix: Use a LEFT JOIN or fetch the setting value first and fall back to `SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id` when no matching category is found, guarding against an empty result before calling `[0]['id']`
validated_findings.title: Migration crashes when no category matches the embed_category site setting value
validated_findings.trigger: Running this migration on any install where the `embed_category` site setting is unset/blank (its documented default) or set to a value that doesn't exactly match an existing category name
validated_findings.verifier_reason: Patch lines 9-11 show migration queries with INNER JOIN expecting result, then accesses `[0]['id']`. If embed_category setting is blank/unset (common default), INNER JOIN returns empty result, causing NoMethodError on nil.

validated_findings.body: The test's asserted color ids (1, 2) actually belong to fruit id 1 (apple), not fruit id 2 (banana, color_ids [3]) that was requested, so the test does not actually validate that the store correctly fetches by id and could mask a real fetch-by-id defect
validated_findings.failure_mode: Test provides false confidence about id-based fetch correctness
validated_findings.impact: The test's asserted color ids (1, 2) actually belong to fruit id 1 (apple), not fruit id 2 (banana, color_ids [3]) that was requested, so the test does not actually validate that the store correctly fetches by id and could mask a real fetch-by-id defect
validated_findings.root_cause: Test was updated to request id=2 without accounting for the fixture endpoint's hardcoded `fruits[0]` response
validated_findings.suggested_fix: Fix the pretender's `/fruits/:id` handler to select the matching fruit by id, or change the test's requested id to match the fixture actually being asserted
validated_findings.title: Test claims to fetch fruit id=2 but asserts data belonging to a different fruit due to fixture ignoring the id param
validated_findings.trigger: Running this 'find embedded' test; the pretender's `/fruits/:id` handler always returns `fruits[0]` regardless of the requested id
validated_findings.verifier_reason: Claim requires knowledge of pretender fixture behavior not shown in patch. The test change from id=1 to id=2 and assertions are visible, but without seeing the fixture handler returning `fruits[0]` regardless of ID, the bug cannot be verified from patch alone.

validated_findings.impact: New admin embeddable-host management endpoints ship with no request-level coverage for success or error paths, allowing regressions to reach production undetected
validated_findings.root_cause: Spec file only asserts class hierarchy and omits behavioral coverage for the newly introduced controller actions
